What it holds
The largest buyer names as written in the registry, with their

TRACE parent and a note.
One row per company group: year, Scope 1, total, boundary, the
report's title and URL, the section the figure is in, and the date it
was checked. Only primary documents.

is none, and what was checked (documents, sites, searches,
date).

logo. Blank when no domain could be verified.
